coherence.rule: Every index uses one common market anchor and horizon start. Components are equal-weighted after unitless normalization by a fixed trailing-five-year robust level scale. The scale is the greater of 1.4826*MAD, half the population standard deviation, or one tenth of the five-year observed range. This avoids percentage explosions for rates, spreads, policy rates and any series near or across zero while preserving direction and comparable contribution magnitude. Low-frequency series use only real published observations; no synthetic daily points or hidden substitutes are created.
